ambient_events: The killing floor is silent in the way a held breath is silent, waiting to be let out.
Bones crunch somewhere out on the floor under a weight far larger than yours, and stop.
description: The killing floor — a flat, open expanse swept clear of everything but bones and the things that made them, where whatever apex the Redline has bred holds court over a court of the dead. People come here to prove something. Their proof is usually their absence.
name: The Killing Floor
